mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (notifIdx, userIdx, notifType, content, url, isRead, createdAt) VALUES (notifSeq.NEXTVAL, #{userIdx}, #{notifType}, #{content}, #{url}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT notifIdx, userIdx, notifType, content, url, isRead, TO_CHAR(createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY notifIdx DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET isRead = 1 WHERE notifIdx = #{notifIdx}
UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET isRead = 1 WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE userIdx = #{userIdx} AND isRead = 0
